internal sealed class ClickSourceEventsImpl : IClickSourceEvents
{
    private readonly global::Demo.ClickSource _sender;
    internal ClickSourceEventsImpl(global::Demo.ClickSource sender)
    {
        _sender = sender;
    }

    public global::R3.Observable<global::R3.Unit> Click => global::R3.Observable.FromEvent<global::System.Action?, global::R3.Unit>(h => () => h(global::R3.Unit.Default), e => _sender.Click += e, e => _sender.Click -= e, default);
}
